title: limonium rariflorum
intro: Limonium rariflorum, commonly known as sea lavender, is a flowering plant species within the family Plumbaginaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce inflammation, and alleviate anxiety, with reported health benefits including its ability to act as a sedative and antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of sea lavender are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as linalool and limonene, that contribute to its calming and anti-inflammatory properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of Limonium rariflorum.
